Block Reality 0.4.0-alpha.1 / Tectonic v2.0.0-alpha.1

Minecraft Java 1.20.1 + Forge 47.x, Java 17.
Copy the single blockreality-*.jar into mods/ on the client and server.
The jar contains Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64 native engines.
Linux requires glibc 2.35 or newer. No sidecar or FrameCore installation.
Alpha: full v2 roadmap and in-game qualification are not complete.
